SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO, KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ, KEY_3 AS DS_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL C WHERE DOC_NAME = 'DSDOWN' AND KEY_10 in ('N','A') AND TARGET IN ('KRCHAN0058','KRCHAN0059','KRCHAN0060','KRDONG0708')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.KEY_5 AS PLANT, A.KEY_6 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, A.KEY_7 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, f_split(key_8,'^',1) AS LEGACY_PO_COUNT, A.KEY_3 AS DS_SEQ, f_split(key_8,'^',2) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, to_number(f_split(key_8,'^',3)) AS ITEM_QTY, f_split(key_8,'^',4) AS DS_DATE, f_split(key_8,'^',5) AS NOTE, to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE, to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_3 = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND A.KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E', KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND KEY_10 in ('A','N')
